description: Connect AI model plans via a configurable vendor profile.
commands.coding-plans.manage.title: Manage Coding Plans Configuration
commands.coding-plans.updateModels.title: Update Coding Plans Models List
configuration.title: Coding Plans
configuration.coding-plans.vendors.descr: Configure AI model vendors, endpoints and models. Validation reports field paths and isolates affected vendors or models while preserving settings; edit configuration manually to match the current schema.
configuration.coding-plans.vendors.model: Whether this model is exposed in Manage Language Models. Set to false to keep the model in configuration while hiding it from the VS Code model picker.
Model capability: total input + output capacity C, normally populated by discovery. For everyday context selection, use contextBudget or the native Context Size picker.

Model capability: optional independent input limit I. When the provider publishes only a total window, omit this field; the input ceiling follows C minus the reserved output. Known independent limits further constrain that ceiling.
Model capability: maximum generation capacity O, normally populated by discovery. Choose the actual request output budget in contextBudget.outputTokens.

Usage policy: adjust default input and actual output budgets here while preserving discovered model capabilities. VS Code manages the native input selection. The suggested 64K/16K snippet is an example; omitted budgets use 400000/50000 subject to model limits.
Default input budget P, initially 400000 tokens, constrained by input capability and the total window after reserving output.
Actual request output budget R, initially 50000 tokens, constrained by output capability and the total window. Sent as max_tokens or max_output_tokens.
Optional numeric input-token presets. Defaults: 32000, 64000, 128000, 256000, 512000. The picker also includes the resolved default and maximum numeric values within model limits.

Discovery metadata, usually maintained automatically. configured preserves explicit limits; endpoint/models.dev permits discovered capability updates while preserving contextBudget. Use configured when intentionally pinning hand-edited capabilities.
Vendor name to add or update in user settings (coding-plans.vendors). The picker only shows this vendor's models.
providers.codingPlans.config.baseUrl.des: HTTP(S) API base URL, e.g. https://api.example.com/v1 (without /chat/completions). Saved in user settings.
providers.codingPlans.config.apiKey.desc: Optional API key stored for the selected vendor via VS Code secret storage.
configuration.coding-plans.terminalInten: Capture run_in_terminal explanation and goal values and show them in the Terminal Intent panel.
Maximum number of recent terminal intent records kept in memory for the Terminal Intent panel.
configuration.coding-plans.commitMessage: Show the "Generate Commit Message" command in Source Control and Command Palette.
configuration.coding-plans.locale.descri: Language for natural-language responses and any reasoning/thinking text emitted by Coding Plans models.
configuration.coding-plans.locale.defaul: Use the language from the request (no override)
configuration.coding-plans.commitMessage: When enabled, read up to the latest 7 local commit messages and mimic their writing style for generated commit messages. This optional style sample is unavailable in VS Code for the Web.
Preferred vendor name for commit message generation (e.g. Zhipu). Leave empty to always prompt.
Preferred model name for commit message generation (e.g. glm-4-flash). Used together with modelVendor.
Advanced commit-message options as a JSON object (prompt, maxDiffLines, pipelineMode, summary* thresholds, max bullet count, subject length, validation switches, llmMaxPromptLength budget).
configuration.coding-plans.logLevel.desc: Sets the native VS Code log level for the Coding Plans output channel.
configuration.coding-plans.autoRefreshMo: Controls automatic model-picker synchronization and refresh on empty queries. Local settings/API-key changes always rebuild configured runtime models immediately, including budgets, even when false. Remote discovery and model-list writeback use the manual Update Coding Plans Models List command.
